fact: Voosbur is a Myconid who released strange spores in the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: A Myconid named Voosbur had released strange spores back in their home, the Neverlight Grove.
subject: Voosbur

fact: The party materialized in the Whorlstone Caverns after walking through fungi following Voosbur's spore release.
source_quote: they had walked through some fungi and materialized here in the Whorlstone Caverns
subject: party teleportation

fact: Rumpadump avoided the madness caused by the spores by refusing to eat the mushrooms.
source_quote: He had avoided the madness that followed because "I did not eat the silly mushrooms."
subject: Rumpadump

fact: The mushrooms Rumpadump refused to eat are the same growy-shrinky mushrooms the party had gathered.
source_quote: These were the same growy-shrinky mushrooms the party had gathered.
subject: growy-shrinky mushrooms

fact: Stool disputes Rumpadump's theory that the mushrooms caused the madness.
source_quote: Stool loudly disputed this theory.
subject: Stool

fact: Rumpadump fears the infection has spread to the rest of his kin in the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: He feared the infection had spread back to the rest of his kin in the Neverlight Grove
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Rumpadump urged the party to help him return to the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: he urged the party to help him return there.
subject: Rumpadump's request

fact: The Myconid Sovereign in the Grove holds the accumulated knowledge of all his predecessors.
source_quote: The Myconid Sovereign who dwells in the Grove holds the accumulated knowledge of all his predecessors
subject: Myconid Sovereign

fact: The Myconid Sovereign might know a way out of the Underdark entirely from the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: might even know a way out of the Underdark entirely.
subject: Neverlight Grove

fact: Reaching the Neverlight Grove requires leaving Gracklstugh.
source_quote: Reaching the Grove, however, would mean leaving Gracklstugh first.
subject: Gracklstugh

fact: Sarith began talking about a Dark Lady calling to him and showing visions.
source_quote: He began talking about a Dark Lady calling to him, and about visions of the Dark Lady.
subject: Sarith

fact: The party's arcana checks regarding the Dark Lady were unsuccessful.
source_quote: The party's arcana checks came up empty
subject: party arcana checks

fact: Daz skipped the sections of his drow training relevant to the Dark Lady identification.
source_quote: Daz had apparently skipped those sections of his drow training.
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum rolled a 23 on a religion check to identify the Dark Lady.
source_quote: Gyrgum... rolled a 23 on religion. He recognized the reference
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The Dark Lady identified by Gyrgum is Zuggtmoy, the Demon Queen of Fungi and Lady of Rot and Decay.
source_quote: the Dark Lady was Zuggtmoy, the Demon Queen of Fungi, Lady of Rot and Decay.
subject: Zuggtmoy

fact: Zuggtmoy's desire is to infect living beings with spores to transform them into mindless servants.
source_quote: She is an alien being whose sole desire is to infect the living with her spores and transform them into mindless servants
subject: Zuggtmoy

fact: Zuggtmoy's servants eventually become decomposing hosts for her fungi.
source_quote: transform them into mindless servants, and eventually into decomposing hosts for her fungi.
subject: Zuggtmoy

fact: Daz recalled that such infection normally requires proximity to the demonic power itself.
source_quote: Daz recalled that such infection normally required proximity to the demonic power itself
subject: Daz's recollection

fact: The party questioned whether the true source of the infection lies at the Grove they were asked to visit.
source_quote: The party wondered whether the true source lay at the very Grove they were being asked to visit.
subject: true source of infection

fact: The party concluded that Sarith was touched by Zuggtmoy's influence before they met him in prison.
source_quote: Sarith had likely been touched by Zuggtmoy's influence well before they met him in prison
subject: Sarith's instability

fact: Sarith had never been mentally stable.
source_quote: they noted he had never been mentally stable.
subject: Sarith

fact: The party considered it possible that Zuggtmoy is abroad, similar to Demogorgon.
source_quote: Since Demogorgon was already abroad, it seemed entirely possible Zuggtmoy was too.
subject: Zuggtmoy abroad

fact: Rumpadump greeted the party by acknowledging they found Stool.
source_quote: "So I see you found my friend Stool."
subject: Rumpadump greeting

fact: Stool repeatedly stated that he found Rumpadump.
source_quote: Stool replies, "I found you. I found you. I found you."
subject: Stool

fact: Rumpadump stated that something is not right.
source_quote: After a silence, Rumpadump says: "something is not right here."
subject: Rumpadump's concern

fact: Rumpadump explained that Voosbur released strange spores that caused the others' madness.
source_quote: Rumpadump explains that a Myconid named Voosbur released strange spores that infected the others and caused their madness.
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Rumpadump pointed out Voosbur, one of the tall Myconids.
source_quote: He points out Voosbur, one of the tall Myconids.
subject: Voosbur

fact: Rumpadump worried that the rest of his Myconids back home were infected.
source_quote: "I'm worried that they might have infected the rest of my Myconids back home.
subject: Rumpadump

fact: Rumpadump asked if the party could help them get to the Neverlight Grove.
source_quote: Can these people help us get there?"
subject: Rumpadump's question

fact: Rumpadump revealed the group materialized in the caverns via fungal teleportation after Voosbur released spores.
source_quote: Rumpadump reveals that the group suddenly materialized in these caverns after Voosbur released spores back in the Neverlight Grove, suggesting a form of fungal teleportation.
subject: fungal teleportation

fact: Rumpadump confirmed the dancers can still communicate.
source_quote: Rumpadump confirms the dancers can still communicate.
subject: Rumpadump

fact: The only dangerous-looking things in the area are two apes, which are far away.
source_quote: the only dangerous-looking things are the two apes, which are far away.
subject: apes status

fact: Sarith showed signs of increasing mental instability as they near the infected Myconids.
source_quote: Sarith begins speaking of a 'Dark Lady' calling to him, showing signs of increasing mental instability as they near the infected Myconids.
subject: Sarith

fact: Gyrgum identified the Dark Lady as Zuggtmoy based on a religion check.
source_quote: Gyrgum recalls religious lore and identifies the 'Dark Lady' as Zuggtmoy
subject: Gyrgum identification

fact: A follow-up religion check by Gyrgum provided no new information.
source_quote: A follow-up religion check (8) gives Gyrgum nothing new.
subject: Gyrgum follow-up

fact: Daz passed an arcana check (16) recalling that proximity to the demonic power is usually required for such infection.
source_quote: Daz's arcana check (16) recalls that, unless this is a natural phenomenon, one must be in proximity to the demonic power
subject: Daz arcana check

fact: The party wonders if the demonic presence might be at the Grove itself.
source_quote: The party wonders whether the demonic presence might be at the Grove itself
subject: demonic presence location

fact: Daz views the Myconids as the only peaceful people in the Underdark.
source_quote: Daz likes the Myconids as "the only peaceful people down here in the Underdark."
subject: Daz
